title: Avin of Tzippori

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.29b.7), it is related that he dragged a bench (on Shabbat) in a marble upper room before Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar.

As for Yuchasin’s statement “in chapter 3 of Horayot, in Reish Lakish’s time,” which puzzled [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=162&lang=en): Hyman explains that a small error slipped into Yuchasin: those words belong to the adjacent entry [Avin Ramaah](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=163&lang=en), an explanation he regards as clear.

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text and translation of Shabbat 29b place Avin’s bench-dragging before Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar, not in a room above him. The upper room has a marble floor; Shisha is not a person here. Hyman attributes the chronological difficulty in Yuchasin to words misplaced from its adjacent Avin Ramaah entry. The two linked Heilprin entries are separate notices. The second supplies parallels for Avin Ramaah, while the proposed relocation of words in Yuchasin is Hyman’s explanation.
